summary:
We worked on a card game focused on decision-making during a NASA space mission. We didn't want to make the game too complex because, in general, when a game is complicated, children tend to avoid playing it because they are afraid they won't understand how it works.

Since the card game is something tangible, we didn't limit ourselves to presenting the idea in a PowerPoint presentation. We also developed a decision-making game based on the same concept and missions featured in the card game, turning it into an interactive HTML file.
details:
The project was created for recreational and educational purposes. It works as a physical card game, and we also developed a web-based version.

One of its main benefits is teaching children about space missions and financial resource management without introducing overly complex concepts. The impact we hope to achieve is to help children see NASA missions as something less overwhelming and more accessible.

We only used AI (ChatGPT, in this case) to generate the HTML code due to the limited time we had left. We had already developed the entire game concept and rules before creating the web version. The cards were designed by our team, while the concept for the card game box was created with the help of Gemini.

We took into consideration the game examples provided by NASA on its Challenges website. After noticing that there wasn't a similar game, we decided to develop our own concept and rules in order to achieve our goal: creating an original game.
